invariants.rationale: maxY is used as a divisor and comparison to zero, suggesting it is non-negative.
amountY is divided by maxY to form a percent, so it may be expected to be non-negative.
amountY likely represents current scroll and maxY is the maximum, so current should not exceed the maximum.
If maxY is zero, the method returns 0, so amountY should also be zero in that case.
The method clamps its return value between 0 and 1, so the result will always be within these bounds.
